purpose: Reads, parses and builds the impacts of a Solution on Values and Development Resources as plain functions: one `t:ImpactOn` relation per pair, with the numbers on the relation.
namedChanges: The only change is the four imports (lines 4-7): `./planCard` (`memberValue`, the type `PlanSourceValue`) is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-plan-card-facts`; `./recordPlane` (`typeLocalName`) is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-type-curie`; `./relationDoc` (`roleIs`) and `./relations` (the type `RecordRelation`) are `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-relation-role`.

library.title: Impacts model (Solution on Value and Resource)
library.note: Pure; the Impacts table on screen is plan-impacts.
